original.statement: OpenShift profile variants for Helm installs are removed and replaced with global.platform=openshift configuration; a new global.platform Helm value enables platform-specific configurations.

corrected.statement: Helm installs that select a removed OpenShift profile variant (e.g. profile=ambient-openshift) are exposed and should switch to the base profile plus global.platform=openshift. Installs that only leave global.platform unset are not exposed.

decision.reason: [ev-d6ef50aec061] says global.platform is an opt-in override and that only the OpenShift profile variants were removed (e.g. profile=ambient-openshift now becomes profile=ambient plus global.platform=openshift). The proposed second disjunct, global.platform unset, would flag nearly every Helm install, but the evidence describes no effect on installs that just don't set the new override. Validators show global.platform already existed in 1.23.4 [ev-41d780f6ab39, ev-ad95ec08c00b], so leaving it unset changes nothing. Only installs using an OpenShift profile variant are exposed. I match any profile name containing "openshift" because the evidence gives only one example name.
